purpose: Inspect recorded API requests, range-scoped request activity, backend process errors, and independently windowed browser error reports.
primaryGoal: Find a request using server filters, inspect complete captured evidence, and export the currently loaded page without confusing request-list scope with diagnostic or summary scope.

dataSources.behavior: Envelope data/total/limit/offset; zero-based page times validated size supplies offset; method, status, endpoint, service, client, key, start and end_exclusive are server parameters. AbortSignal is forwarded; polling is INTERVALS.FAST (10000ms). Existing inherited cache/retry policy is not overridden here.
dataSources.verification: Frontend request construction and mounted router declarations inspected; HTTP execution, database ordering/filtering and authorization outcomes unverified.

dataSources.behavior: Both exact range bounds are passed; incomplete bound pairs throw in adapter. Range summaries and service counts ignore request-list filters. last_24h remains an independent rolling measure with exact backend bounds absent from response. Polling is INTERVALS.STANDARD (30000ms); AbortSignal forwarded.
dataSources.verification: Route and source contracts inspected; aggregate formulas, percent scale and last_24h backend bounds not independently verified.

dataSources.behavior: Process-lifetime totals, uptime and categories, independent of selected request range/filters. Sort categories descending by count. Polling 30000ms; AbortSignal forwarded.
dataSources.verification: Router declaration and frontend process-scope explanation inspected; tracker lifecycle and cross-pod behavior unverified.

dataSources.behavior: Independent component-owned query; total, top sources, window_seconds, as_of. Explicit one-hour/general/unknown-window text; categories sorted descending. Polling 30000ms; AbortSignal forwarded. Zero received reports never implies zero actual browser errors.
dataSources.verification: Router comments identify the shared ingest/summary handler instance; browser reporting delivery, disabled reporting and rolling-window accuracy unverified.

components.name: PageLayout / PageContainer
components.contract: Existing full-width min-w-0 container, title/help, semantic secondaryActions, logs-query freshness, busy announcement and error boundary. No page-wide loading/error/empty prop is supplied, so independent source sections remain mounted.

components.name: OperationalBrief / ApiLogsSummary
components.contract: Two compact briefs, four metrics, source-state labels, scope/provenance, retained/error notices and shared Review details drawers. Latency adapter converts source milliseconds to formatter seconds, then displays milliseconds; never change wire/cache values.

components.name: DataTable / ApiLogsEvidenceTable
components.contract: Stable tableId admin:api-logs; nine columns; server pagination/filters; column visibility, resize, reorder and density controls; controlled single-row expansion; loaded-page CSV/JSON controls. Do not replace with another table pipeline.

components.name: GlassPanel, Button, Badge, Text/Caption/PanelTitle, Input/Select/Label, CodeBlock/CopyButton
components.contract: Category-barrel imports; semantic text and native named controls; pretty-printed JSON with raw fallback and copy; no new surface, control or code-view implementation.

components.name: ApiLogsRuntimeCard / ApiLogsRuntimeList
components.contract: Shared by both error panels: generated title identity, labeled region, count/context/loading skeleton, independent children and keyboard-focusable scroll region.

components.name: DateTime / FormattedNumber / useNumberFormatting / useOperationalMetrics
components.contract: Existing locale/precision preferences and UTC-input datetime rendering; preserve raw identifiers, payloads and source units. Formatter implementations not independently audited.

components.name: useDataState, StaleRefreshWarning, QueryError, EmptyState, Skeleton, FadeIn
components.contract: Retained payload is never blanked by refresh failure; fatal errors are source-specific; paused retained queries show offline warning. FadeIn consults existing motion preference rather than adding animation policy.

duplicatedPatterns.detail: Quick-pick Button overrides duplicate surface/selection treatment despite existing control tokens; special padding overrides also compete with density sizing.
duplicatedPatterns.fix: Keep quick-pick behavior and aria-pressed, but use existing muted control/selected/focus tokens and reachable sizing rather than a new chip component.

duplicatedPatterns.detail: Backend/browser error headings, count/context and scrolling evidence already share RuntimeCard/RuntimeList. The independent query branches are semantically different, not grounds to merge sources.
duplicatedPatterns.fix: Retain these existing owners; no speculative shared error-dashboard composite is justified by this one-page audit.

sourceBehavior.detail: Diagnostic cards stack below lg and become two columns at lg; service chips and table header wrap.
Details headers/bodies stack then become two columns at lg; request URL and evidence text wrap/scroll locally.
Mobile endpoint cell duplicates method/service/time/duration and truncated error, retaining full evidence in expansion.
mobileColumns is an under-md visibility allow-list, not automatic card transformation. Caller supplies no mobilePresentation.

issues.detail: Under-md allow-list retains method, endpoint, status, service, client and optional key, while endpoint content repeats method/service. Multiple minimum-width columns can make the phone table wide; this is a source-based overflow/redundancy risk, not a measured viewport failure.
issues.fix: Use the current DataTable mobile strategy to prioritize endpoint/status and preserve access to every filter, metadata field and full detail. Verify container scrolling rather than hiding capabilities.

responsive.runtimeStatus: UNVERIFIED: no route mounted, viewport capture or horizontal-scroll measurement.

sourceStrengths: Named API-log/error-diagnostics sections; decorative icons aria-hidden; service toggles expose aria-pressed (ApiLogsPage.tsx:276-286,309-310,425-428).
Labeled Input/Select filters and named CopyButtons; raw payloads are rendered as text rather than HTML (ApiLogsEvidenceTable.tsx:52-85,98-107,179-207).
Runtime cards use useId and aria-labelledby; lists are focusable scroll regions with visible focus styling (ApiLogsRuntimeCard.tsx:19-22; ApiLogsRuntimeList.tsx:5-8).

DataTable expansion uses native button and aria-expanded; shared touch-target-overlay expands pointer hit area to at least 44px (DataTable.tsx:1128-1147; index.css:1958-1970). Overlap still needs browser verification.
Shared FadeIn reduced-motion branch uses initial=false and ignored delay; actual OS/low-bandwidth behavior not exercised (FadeIn.tsx:24-35).

issues.detail: Expand/collapse names are generic for every request. Caller provides rowLabel, but inspected renderer uses it for selectable-row names, not expansion. Requests cannot be distinguished by expansion-button name alone.
issues.fix: Extend existing expansion label calculation to reuse rowLabelFor with localized named expand/collapse fallbacks; preserve aria-expanded, keyboard operation and legacy fallback. No second table implementation.

issues.detail: Service quick-picks override Button height/padding. Other sm actions default to h-9. No page-specific 44px minimum is visible; effective spacing exceptions/target size have not been measured.
issues.fix: Use existing Button sizing/wrapLabel or touch-target utilities where appropriate; verify touch regions do not overlap and long translated labels fit.

accessibility.runtimeStatus: UNVERIFIED: keyboard sequence, focus restoration, screen-reader output, contrast, forced colors, RTL and 200% text were not exercised.

states.loading: Independent first-load skeletons: summary brief measurements; five service skeletons; eight request-row skeletons; backend/browser count and evidence skeletons. Evidence table itself remains mounted before request-state branch.
states.empty: No service activity message; request no-logs explanation with filter-clear recovery only when list filters exist; explicit zero-runtime/no-browser-reports messages versus missing breakdown. Source sections remain mounted.
states.error: Source-specific fatal QueryError and retries for services, requests, backend and browser errors. Summary exposes fatal/refresh error text and source-state label; global Refresh can retry stats.
states.staleOffline: Retained rows/categories remain visible; shared warnings appear for list/services/runtime/browser. hideRetry on first three relies on global Refresh; browser keeps independent retry. DataState represents paused retained reads as stale/isRefreshBlocked.
states.partialUnknown: Optional measurements remain undefined/null in summary formatting. Backend/browser unknown totals and context display dash. Null headers/bodies explain missing evidence; loaded request total is guarded in caption. No mocked data introduced.

issues.detail: Global Refresh disables/refetches logs, stats and backend runtime only. Frontend errors own a fourth query in their child; global action neither refreshes it nor includes its busy state.
issues.fix: Either expose a narrowly typed frontend refresh/busy bridge and preserve that independent query, or make the global action's three-source scope explicit. Keep the existing frontend stale retry and polling.

issues.rule: MDC-026: unknown is not measured zero
issues.detail: Missing request envelope defaults total to 0 and passes it into pagination while table is mounted before loading/fatal branches. Caption correctly uses dash when data is absent, but pager's first-load/offline appearance requires verification.
issues.fix: Keep a real empty total distinct from unavailable total and disable or appropriately label pagination until an envelope exists, using current DataTable/Pagination contracts.

visualIssues.rule: MDC-010/MDC-012: no fixed-white or saturated decorative chrome
visualIssues.detail: Selected service uses fixed bg-white/[0.06] and ring-cyan-400/30 instead of adaptive control/accent tokens. This is a fixed-white translucent surface, not pure-white body text or demonstrated glow.
visualIssues.fix: Use current theme-aware muted control/selected-border tokens; keep pressed indication and service identity. Do not force-reset saved theme IDs.

visualIssues.detail: Decorative Layers icon is fixed cyan-300; service identity chips assign info/warning hue to vendors, repeated alongside already colored method and status badges. Geocoder service identity is warning-colored even without an actual error.
visualIssues.fix: Make decoration and ordinary service identity neutral; reserve restrained semantic hue for actual request status/rate limiting/errors. Preserve all vendor labels and counts.

visualIssues.rule: MDC-015/MDC-023: avoid nested competing surface frames
visualIssues.detail: DataTable defaults to standalone frame; caller already encloses it in GlassPanel with its own title/header. The shared frame adds another border/radius/shadow surface (tokens.ts:67), potentially making the evidence workspace visually box-heavy.
visualIssues.fix: Use existing variant="embedded" for the table within its panel after verifying toolbar, scroll and persistence behavior; retain panel header and all controls.

visualIssues.detail: The active page's shared row expander retains fixed-white hover and cyan focus ring. These are source-confirmed fixed palette accents, not measured contrast failures.
visualIssues.fix: Shared table owner should reuse control hover and focus-ring tokens without removing focus or touch-target overlay.

architectureIssues.detail: Page URL value is not clamped to a non-negative integer. useUrlNumber accepts any finite number, while adapter computes offset=page*size. Negative/fractional manually entered page values can generate invalid offsets; backend rejection behavior was not inspected.
architectureIssues.fix: Normalize page locally through existing URL-state mechanism, retaining zero-based URL and one-based pagination display. Do not change shared numeric parsing for unrelated users.

architectureIssues.detail: Error-count comparison uses String(stats.error_count) while page counts otherwise use saved number formatting. The comparison also carries a trend/increased cue without a supplied previous-period comparison.
architectureIssues.fix: Use existing locale formatting for the count and keep source-backed error emphasis without implying an unverified temporal trend. Preserve >5 threshold and actual error count unless product meaning is separately resolved.

priority.rationale: Page already uses shared layout, real typed queries, independent states and evidence preservation. Prioritize mobile/table discoverability, accessible row identities and data/action scope before decorative changes.
order: Resolve shared row-expansion names/focus tokens and verify non-overlapping touch targets.
Confirm complete mobile access to server filters and request evidence.
Clarify Refresh scope, unavailable pagination and URL-page validity.
Subdue fixed cyan/white/vendor-warning decoration; reuse embedded table.
Verify localized summary comparison and source-backed semantics.

requiredSharedChanges.name: Existing DataTable expansion accessibility and theme token closeout
requiredSharedChanges.detail: Current expandable evidence rows have indistinguishable button names and fixed white/cyan hover/focus treatment.
requiredSharedChanges.fix: Reuse existing rowLabel/rowLabelFor for localized named expansion actions; use existing control/focus tokens; keep generic fallback and touch hit-region behavior.

propsVariantsStates.acceptance: Unique request identity in expand/collapse accessible names; unchanged single-row control; visible adaptive focus; no overlapping 44px hit areas in compact rows.

dependsOn: existing i18n table expansion keys or shared-owner catalog extension
requiredSharedChanges.scopeLimit: Only this production consumer was inspected; no claim of two-consumer inventory or authorization to create a new composite. Audit worker made no shared edits.

competingImplementations.detail: Unused-by-this-page useApiLogs returns an array/page query, alongside actual envelope-based useAPICallLogs with offset/filter/range/size key. Similar capitalization hides distinct contracts; useApiLogStats also lacks selected range.
competingImplementations.fix: Preserve actual envelope/range hooks here. Shared API owner may assess other consumers before consolidation; no deletion or migration is authorized by this scoped audit.

actions: Refresh logs, range stats and backend process summary; preserve documented independent frontend behavior until explicitly corrected.
Service quick-pick toggle and server method/status/endpoint/service/client/key filters; clear filters while retaining range and size.
Atomic filter-plus-page URL update via useUrlBatch; range change resets nonzero page.
Server pagination and sizes 25/50/100; zero-based page URL to one-based control conversion.
Persistent resize/reorder/visibility/density for tableId admin:api-logs; optional hidden App key column.
Expand/collapse at most one request; inspect/copy request URL, verified installation ID, request/response headers and bodies.
CSV/JSON loaded-page download with teslasync-api-logs-YYYY-MM-DD filename and existing privacy redaction.
Independent source retries and shared OperationalBrief Review details drawers.
Navigate to /system-status from backend error evidence.
dataBehavior: Header owns range through useRangeState persistKey api-logs.range, default all; startInstant/endInstantExclusive/timezone/preset semantics survive. workspaceScope enables range and disables global vehicle selector for this fleet-wide route.
Logs query applies full-server predicates rather than loaded-page client filtering. Summary/service counts use only range; browser and process summaries have different scopes.
Service dropdown is union of 11 known service tags, actual by_service keys and active unknown selection, sorted by localized label with All services first; chips sort descending count.
Preserve nine columns: time, method, endpoint, status, service, duration, client, optional key, error; status null remains N/A and missing evidence stays dash/explanation.

Application identity derives from X-Teslasync-App using allowed platform plus UUIDv4 pattern; table installation metadata requires verified numeric App-Key-ID with name. Exports retain their current separate identity rules.

CSV fields retain id, timestamp, vehicle_id, service, app_installation, app_key_id, app_key_name, method, endpoint, status_code, duration_ms, rate_limited, error, request_body, response_body, request_headers, response_headers. JSON keeps original loaded records through privacy helper.

Evidence viewer pretty-prints valid JSON and copies exactly displayed text; invalid payload stays raw. Capture explanation retains API_LOG_CAPTURE_BODIES, 10KB cap, safe diagnostic headers/redaction and irrecoverable missing legacy fields. These statements were not backend-validated.
Preserve source duration_ms and API fields. ApiLogsSummary's milliseconds-to-seconds conversion is a formatter boundary, not a new wire migration.
Retain source rows on refresh failure/offline; do not gate every section on one successful request or replace unknown counts with fabricated zero.

evidenceLimits.mode: Phase 0 read-only, one mounted-route source audit; no source/UI changes.
evidenceLimits.runtime: UNVERIFIED: no server start, route navigation, live API read, fixture mount, screenshot or production action.
evidenceLimits.visual: UNVERIFIED: no measured contrast, actual glow/saturation, theme screenshot, responsive overflow, open overlay, RTL or long-content rendering. Findings distinguish fixed-color source from observed appearance.
evidenceLimits.keyboardA11y: UNVERIFIED: no keyboard, focus, screen reader, touch overlap, forced colors or OS reduced-motion exercise.
evidenceLimits.backend: Only relevant router declarations/comments were inspected. Handler/database implementation, aggregate computations, sorting, retention, capture limits/redaction, authorization and multi-pod behavior were not validated.
evidenceLimits.sharedScope: Shared owners were read only to resolve this page's actual contracts. No application-wide component audit, additional production-consumer inventory or query-provider/theme-provider audit.
evidenceLimits.validation: No TypeScript, full lint/build, tests, Git, nested agents or production actions. The loaded audit-violations script was inspected but not executed because its unconditional project TypeScript phase conflicts with this assignment's bounded source-only audit.

staticEvidence.scope: Root page plus eight explicitly enumerated page-specific presentation/helper files in preservation.pageSpecificDependencyLineCounts.
staticEvidence.method: PowerShell Select-String -CaseSensitive on explicit paths; Get-Content line counts; Get-FileHash -Algorithm SHA256.
staticEvidence.caveat: Text-pattern counts are not semantic/runtime acceptance. An initial count omitted -CaseSensitive and falsely counted PascalCase shared controls; corrected output above supersedes it. Earlier malformed quoted command exited 1 and was corrected. No literal neon/glow or pure-white text was found in scoped feature files, but fixed-white/cyan decoration and repeated semantic badges are actively flagged.

evidenceLimits.concurrency: Root source SHA-256 matched at repeated reads. Dependencies were read from the live working tree, not an atomic frozen snapshot; parallel source drift remains possible.
